name: Dark Child
source: Miji is a small cute girl who lives with her mother. One day when playing at her houses garden she gets lost and meets a mysterious boy. What will Miji do to go back? Who is this strange boy? What will awaits Miji in the future?...
translation: 米吉是一个可爱的小女孩，和她的妈妈住在一起。有一天，她在自家花园玩耍时迷路了，并遇到了一名神秘男孩。米吉要回去做什么？这个奇怪的男孩是谁？未来等待着米吉的将是什么呢？
